en-US.longDescription: Netpas Message is a maritime-focused email system designed to enhance message efficiency while maintaining the core functionalities of a traditional email program. It analyzes vessel data from incoming emails, stores it in the Vessel Manager database, and enables circulation via Open Tonnage. The Project feature automatically organizes operation-related emails by task, enhancing focus and maximizing work efficiency. Furthermore, users can share projects with team members, facilitating not only the exchange of ongoing work emails but also the seamless sharing of insights and resources for improved collaboration.
en-US.name: Netpas Message

zh-CN.description: 您的沟通不止于电子邮件
zh-CN.longDescription: Netpas Message 是一款专为海事领域设计的邮件系统，在保留传统邮件核心功能的同时显著提升通信效率。该系统能智能解析邮件中的船舶数据，自动存储至 Vessel Manager 数据库，并通过 Open Tonnage 实现数据流转。其特色“项目”功能可按任务自动归类业务邮件，帮助用户聚焦关键工作，实现效率最大化。用户还可将项目共享给团队成员，不仅实现工作邮件的实时同步，更能便捷交流业务见解与资源，打造无缝协作体验。
